defects.description: Incorrect translation of "Role Status"; used "статусы Роль" instead of the required "Статус роли".
The term "findings" was translated as "результаты"; the required glossary equivalent is "Вывод".
Incorrect form of "role" in the phrase "выходов Роль"; should be "выходов роли" (using the required term "Роль").
Code token/key name changed from "role_agent_config" to "Роль_agent_config", breaking byte‑identical requirement.
